error: the per-repetition environment check applied the PRE-CAMPAIGN idle quiescence gate to samples taken WHILE the benchmark was running
consequence: all 150 repetitions of run 1 were marked INVALID_ENVIRONMENT

evidence_this_was_a_category_error.interpretation: elevated load during a repetition is the benchmark's own 16-way concurrent traffic, i.e. the workload under test, not background contention

correction: a repetition is invalidated by FOREIGN contention only: orphaned experiment processes, swap pressure, or memory exhaustion. Load thresholds continue to gate whether the campaign may START.
not_a_goalpost_move: no benchmark parameter changed; no comparative or gate result was computed or inspected before the correction; run 1 is preserved intact rather than relabelled
disposition: run 1 retained for provenance under results/steady-state-run1-provenance and excluded from headline estimators; the campaign is re-run from repetition 1 under the corrected criterion
